interface.signature: def maxCandies(status: List[int], candies: List[int], keys: List[List[int]], containedBoxes: List[List[int]], initialBoxes: List[int]) -> int:

preconditions.expression: len(status) == len(candies) == len(keys) == len(containedBoxes) and 1 <= len(status) <= 1000
preconditions.description: All input lists have the same length, and the length is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(status[i] in {0, 1} for i in range(len(status)))
all(1 <= candies[i] <= 1000 for i in range(len(candies)))
all(0 <= len(keys[i]) <= len(status) and all(0 <= keys[i][j] < len(status) for j in range(len(keys[i]))) and len(set(keys[i])) == len(keys[i]) for i in range(len(keys)))
preconditions.description: Each keys[i] contains unique indices of boxes, and all indices are within bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= len(containedBoxes[i]) <= len(status) and all(0 <= containedBoxes[i][j] < len(status) for j in range(len(containedBoxes[i]))) and len(set(containedBoxes[i])) == len(containedBoxes[i]) for i in range(len(containedBoxes)))
preconditions.description: Each containedBoxes[i] contains unique indices of boxes, and all indices are within bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= initialBoxes[i] < len(status) for i in range(len(initialBoxes)))
preconditions.description: All indices in initialBoxes are within bounds.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(candies[i] for i in range(len(status)) if i in accessible_boxes)
postconditions.description: The returned value is the sum of candies in all accessible boxes, where accessible_boxes is the set of all boxes that can be opened starting from initialBoxes.

postconditions.expression: all(i in accessible_boxes or status[i] == 0 for i in range(len(status)))
postconditions.description: A box is either accessible or closed (status[i] == 0).

postconditions.expression: all(i in accessible_boxes for i in initialBoxes)
postconditions.description: All boxes in initialBoxes are accessible.

postconditions.expression: all(i in accessible_boxes for i in containedBoxes[j] if j in accessible_boxes)
postconditions.description: If a box j is accessible, all boxes contained in j are also accessible.

postconditions.expression: all(i in accessible_boxes for i in keys[j] if j in accessible_boxes and status[i] == 0)
postconditions.description: If a box j is accessible and contains a key for box i, then box i is accessible (if it was closed).
